tools.detail: Hashcat is a widely-used, high-performance password cracking tool designed for developers and security professionals. It leverages rule-based masks and time-memory trade-offs to crack passwords efficiently. Key features include support for numerous hash types, including MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and many more. It also offers GPU acceleration, making it one of the fastest password crackers available. Hashcat is particularly useful for penetration testing and security audits. It is for those who require a robust and versatile tool to test the strength of their password policies. While it is highly effective, its complexity and the potential for misuse may be limitations for some users.
